messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning a variant swap in the catalog tonight: aurora-3b:v2 -> aurora-3b:v3. Target quiet window 22:00 PT. Who can own the swap, smoke, and rollback?
Sam: I can be on-call for capacity/carving if we need shard adjustments. What's the expected memory delta?
Maya: Thanks Sam. v3 is ~8% larger in kv cache usage per recent perf run. Should be fine for the slot but want to avoid surprises.
Lucas: I can run the canary/smoke. Will do warmup + sample requests against staging then a small production ring (5%).
Taylor: I'll own rollback for the swap (alias revert + cache flush plan). I'll also stand by for LB routing if we need to drain. :thumbsup:
Adrian: One quick question — are we doing alias-swap or pinning the new variant to the slot?
Maya: Alias-swap. We'll update catalog alias aurora-3b:stable -> aurora-3b:v3 and leave the previous version as aurora-3b:v2 pinned to its slot for immediate revert.
Jin: Posting the small deploy snippet we use for alias swap in case people want to run manual:
```bash
# update alias to new variant
curl -X POST 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDFLOW_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  https://catalog.internal/api/v1/aliases/update 
  -d '{"alias":"aurora-3b:stable","variant":"aurora-3b:v3","reason":"nightly swap"}'
```
Lucas: Smoke checklist I'm planning: 1) 50 sample completions with expected token rates; 2) embed similarity sanity check on 100 examples; 3) latency p50/p95 check under load generator; 4) quick A/B on rerank shim. If all green, expand to 5% traffic.
Sam: I'll verify autoscaler thresholds and reserved slot capacity before we flip. Also will watch for OOM signals.
Taylor: Rollback steps (short): 1) update alias back to v2; 2) trigger warmup on v2 (curl batch warmup); 3) monitor KV cache fill & p95 latency; 4) confirm traffic shift completed. I have the playbook ready.
Maya: Great. Who can do the actual alias update at 22:00 PT? Lucas/Taylor?
Lucas: I can execute the alias update and kick off the canary. Will ping here when I start.
Taylor: I'll be ready to revert within 10m if anything bad.
deploy-bot: Scheduled quiet window lock for channel eng-ml at 22:00 PT. Reminder will post at 21:45 PT.
Adrian: Quick CR ping — PR #6821 updates the catalog schema for variant metadata. @Maya @Lucas can you review? It's small.
Maya: Reviewing now, aiming to merge by 20:15 PT if no blockers.
Sam: If merged, Sam: I'll pre-reserve a warm spare slot in the pool as contingency.
Jin: One more note: telemetry tags we want on this swap -> service=aurora, rollout=aurora-v3-swap, owner=eng-ml. Add to the alias update payload.
Maya: Good call. Add to snippet before we flip.
Lucas: Plan: merge PR by 20:15, final thumbs by 20:30, smoke dry-run in staging 20:45, merge + flip 22:00. If no objections by 20:30, proceed.
Taylor: :thumbsup: I'll be on pager and Slack at 21:50 onward.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll squeeze in the doc update and post a short rollback checklist here before 21:30.
Lucas: Ping me when you're about to flip, I'll post canary results in thread.
Maya: Sounds good.
